overview_description.description: Voicegem is a web and iOS app offering an easy way to send voice messages to anyone. Users of Voicegem are provided with the facility to record long messages, and send it to anyone through an email or Facebook message. The recipients (friends or family) of the Voicegem messages can listen and reply to voice messages without installing or signing up with any platform.

about_short_description.short_description: Voicegem is a web and iOS based voice messaging platform.

product.name: VoiceGem
product.description: A platform that allows users to send voice messages via email or Facebook, providing an alternative to phone calls for asynchronous communication.

product.name: VoiceGem for Developers
product.description: A tool for developers to integrate a voice feedback widget into websites, enabling visitors to leave voice messages easily.

product.name: Instant Sending (Streaming)
product.description: A feature that streams voice recordings directly to the server, reducing the wait time for sending messages.

product.name: Facebook Integration
product.description: A feature that allows users to send voice messages to Facebook friends, expanding the platform's reach beyond email.
